title: Project Registers — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An employee's salary costs for one period, split by project. The Project Cost Engine builds it from the period's salary register; it runs only for a regular payroll whose control record is locked and current, and running it again replaces the figures. Written by the Project Cost Engine; there is normally no reason to add or change entries by hand.

fields.label: Employee
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from the employee list.
